term.emergencyFund.name: Emergency fund
term.emergencyFund.simple: Money kept aside only for surprises.
term.emergencyFund.life: A cracked phone screen is paid for without borrowing.
term.emergencyFund.real: Emergency fund = savings kept easy to reach, to pay for costs you could not plan for.
term.liquidity.name: Liquidity
term.liquidity.simple: How quickly something turns into cash.
term.liquidity.life: Money in a savings account is there today. A locked deposit is not.
term.liquidity.real: Liquidity = how quickly and cheaply something can be turned into cash without losing value.
term.recurringDeposit.name: Recurring deposit (RD)
term.recurringDeposit.simple: A fixed amount saved every month for a fixed time.
term.recurringDeposit.life: ₹500 a month for 6 months comes back as about ₹3,057.
term.recurringDeposit.real: Recurring deposit = a deposit made in equal monthly instalments for a fixed tenure at a fixed interest rate.
term.maturity.name: Maturity
term.maturity.simple: The day a deposit ends and the money comes back.
term.maturity.life: Your 6-month RD finishes and the full amount lands in your account.
term.maturity.real: Maturity = the end of a deposit's or policy's term, when the amount due is paid.
term.buffer.name: Buffer
term.buffer.simple: Spare money that absorbs a shock.
term.premium.name: Premium
term.premium.simple: The amount you pay regularly for insurance cover.
term.claim.name: Claim
term.claim.simple: Asking the insurer to pay for a loss the policy covers.
term.sumAssured.name: Sum assured
term.sumAssured.simple: The most an insurance policy will pay.
term.termEndowment.name: Term and endowment plans
term.termEndowment.simple: Term plans pay only on death. Endowment plans also pay a maturity amount and usually cost more for the same cover.
term.disclosure.name: Disclosure
term.disclosure.simple: Telling the insurer the truth about your health and habits when you buy.
term.instalment.name: Instalment
term.instalment.simple: One of the equal payments made into an RD or towards a loan.
term.prematureClosure.name: Premature closure
term.prematureClosure.simple: Closing a deposit before maturity. The bank pays less interest.
